description: PROP-B4-no-human-escalation claims tier-1 static-analysis: 'no code path creates a gh issue with label=escalation whose body contains owner/dais/human/please/manual handling phrases'. Static analysis on shell scripts (bot2bot.sh is bash) cannot reliably tie a runtime-constructed --body file to a runtime-set --label. The body comes from a body-file argument (REQ-B1), which is composed dynamically. A plain text grep over bot2bot.sh source will never see runtime body content. Tier-1 static-analysis is mechanically incapable of enforcing this property. Either downgrade to runtime contract testing or change the mechanism (e.g., a wrapper that programmatically refuses the label/body combination).
